# Generated by tools/ai.py - ambition: AI countries at peace now and then set their eyes on a weaker neighbour
on_actions = {
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					has_war = no
					is_subject = no
					num_divisions > 2
					has_stability > 0.4
				}
				random_list = {
					3 = {
						random_neighbor_country = {
							limit = {
								is_subject = no
								NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
								NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
								ROOT = { strength_ratio = { tag = PREV ratio > 1.5 } }
							}
							ROOT = {
								create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = PREV }
								log = "ANTE|[GetDateText]|ambition|[ROOT.GetTag]|[PREV.GetTag]"
							}
						}
					}
					97 = { }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
